title: The Apothecary Diaries
description: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she’s sold as a lowly servant to the emperor’s palace. But she wasn’t meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she’s making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After being kidnapped and forced to work as a servant in the rear palace, former apothecary Maomao inadvertently draws the attention of the higher ranks when she investigates what's causing the emperor's infant heirs to fall mysteriously ill.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Maomao tries to settle into her promotion to lady-in-waiting and food taster, but struggles to fend off both boredom and the overly-familiar Jinshi. That is, until she gets an assignment of her dreams: to concoct an aphrodisiac.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Tasked with investigating a ghostly woman dancing nightly on the palace walls, Maomao finds a sleepwalking Concubine Fuyou. But with no medicinal cure for sleepwalking, she's forced to dig deeper to find the real reason behind Fuyou's affliction.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Under direct orders from the emperor himself, Maomao tries to care for an ailing Concubine Lihua, but finds her work impeded by Lihua's own ladies-in-waiting.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: A eunuch stricken by a curse comes begging for aid. Meanwhile, the rear palace buzzes with excitement as everyone prepares for the upcoming garden party, and Gyokuyou's ladies-in-waiting aren't about to let Maomao get away without dressing her up.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Maomao does her best to navigate the complex social situations at the garden party, including meeting the other Upper First rank concubines. But once she settles down to do her work as a food-taster, she discovers a surprise in a bowl of soup.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Gaoshun goes to Maomao to get her help in resolving the events of the garden party. Later, Xiaolan explains the purpose of the hairpins Maomao was gifted, and Maomao makes a deal with Lihaku in order to finally visit home.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Maomao's peaceful morning at home is interrupted when she's called in to investigate an apparent double suicide at one of the local brothels.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: An older acquaintance of Jinshi's dies while drinking at a party. A servant's body turns up in a moat. Both deaths are written off as self-inflicted, but Maomao's keen observations tell her that there's more to both stories.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A tea party hosted by Lady Gyokuyou puts the politics of the rear palace at the forefront, and Maomao learns something new about Lady Lishu. His true intentions unclear, Jinshi sends Maomao to work for Lady Ah-Duo.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Maomao confronts Fengming about the dark secret she's been hiding from her noble Lady Ah-Duo.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Discovering that Maomao's kidnappers were connected to Fengming's family, Jinshi is faced with a choice between keeping Maomao in the rear palace where he can be near her or releasing her from her service.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: To Maomao's surprise, Jinshi brings her directly to his house instead of taking her back to the rear palace, and tells her she's to work in the outer court. Not only is there much to learn, it seems there's many eyes on her as the new hire.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Ah-Duo's replacement has arrived in the rear palace, and Maomao is assigned to give a certain lecture to all four high concubines. Later, Maomao helps Lihaku investigate a warehouse explosion.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Gaoshun requests Maomao's help in solving an apparent poisoning case. Meanwhile, Jinshi deals with an unwelcome visitor who's taken to lingering in his office.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: A shack, a chest of drawers, and a fishbowl are all that a talented metalworker leaves to his three sons upon his death. Maomao is assigned to investigate how these strange inheritances all fit together.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Covering up Jinshi's otherworldly beauty is no easy task, but after Maomao takes the challenge head-on, she's surprised when she's also asked to don the disguise of a noblewoman and escort "Jinka" outside the palace.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Back at home, Maomao visits an annex building at the Verdigris House that hides one of the brothel's secrets. Lakan continues to antagonize Jinshi as his connection to Maomao becomes clear.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: A discussion with Lihaku about recent events leads Maomao to realize that the mysteries she's helped to solve are connected. As the final piece of the puzzle falls into place, she rushes to stop impending disaster.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Maomao was able to stop the assassination attempt, but was heavily injured in the process. However, the injuries aren't enough to stop her curiosity, driving her to confront the culprit behind the incident.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Back to work at the rear palace, Maomao listens to Guen talk about his family's business. Meanwhile, Lihaku hears a rumor that whips him into action.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Lakan challenges Jinshi to produce blue roses to present at the upcoming garden party, forcing Jinshi to turn once again to Maomao for her help.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: No longer willing to keep running away from Lakan, Maomao decides to face off against him. She challenges him on his own turf, in a chess match.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Lakan must now choose a courtesan to buy out. As a high-ranking military official, he can afford to freely choose, even from one of the Three Princesses. Who will he choose? Who does Maomao really want him to choose?

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: A concubine passes away, and a woman goes missing. Jinshi sends Maomao to investigate - not these incidents, but mushrooms growing in the rear palace.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: In order to realize the seemingly impossible request from the foreign envoy, Maomao speaks to the “Moon Fairy” herself.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The woman from the clinic finds out that Maomao knows a thing or two about medicine, and asks for her help.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Maomao's investigation of the "curse" reveals more about the late emperor than anticipated.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Maomao joins some women exchanging scary stories on a hot summer night to provide chills.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Maomao has been missing for ten days now. Jinshi's investigations lead him to a forgotten graveyard.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: The village holds a festival. Maomao attends, and Shisui introduces some of the village's history to her.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Maomao is accused of attempting to escape, and is tossed into an ancient method of torture and execution.

episodes_data.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Jinshi and his forces infiltrate the stronghold, cornering the remaining Shi clan members.
